description: The finite conjunction of the renamed axioms is true under any assignment exactly when the structure models their renamed finite theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.realize_finiteConj.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  {M : Type w} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.doubled L n).Structure M] (b : Bool)
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Sentence) (a : Fin n → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.finiteConj b Γ).Realize a ↔
    M ⊨ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side b).onTheory ↑Γ
